groups.description: Minecraft Java 1.21.x: one Fabric jar and one NeoForge jar for the whole 1.21 line, each built against a reference version with broad supported-version metadata. Fabric for 1.20–1.20.6 lives under minecraft_1_20.

Minecraft Java 1.20 through 1.20.6: Fabric on every patch (1.20, 1.20.1, …, 1.20.6) via one unified Fabric jar (reference 1.20.6, Fabric Loader 0.16.10, Fabric API 0.100.8+1.20.6, fabric.mod.json minecraft >=1.20 <1.20.7). NeoForge unified jar covers 1.20.2–1.20.6 only (mods.toml [1.20.2,1.20.7)); 1.20 and 1.20.1 are Fabric-only here (Forge is separate).

Minecraft Java 26.1.x: split from 1.21.x because mappings/toolchains diverge. One Fabric jar and one NeoForge jar for the whole 26.1 line, each built against a reference version with broad supported-version metadata.
Minecraft Java 1.12.x: one Forge jar for the whole 1.12 line built against 1.12.2.
